activities.text: A twist of straw to each shoot, along the terrace and back.

activities.name: Gather fuel-wood
activities.text: Dead wood only, by forest law, bundled and carried out.

activities.name: Bundle herbs to dry
activities.text: Small bunches, stems up, tied to a beam out of the hen's reach.

activities.name: Sit under the oaks
activities.text: Say nothing. After a while, the wind does not sound like wind.

activities.name: Herd the goats
activities.text: Up to the grass at dawn, and count the bells home.

activities.name: Carry iron up
activities.text: A sack of old iron on your back, and a long stair of rock.

activities.name: Break ore
activities.text: A hammer, a block and a heap that never shrinks.

activities.name: Set eel-pots
activities.text: Wicker pots in the channels, staked against the tide.

activities.name: Sift the spoil
activities.text: Earth through the sieve, and look at what stays behind.

activities.name: Trim the lamps
activities.text: Oil and wick for each, down the long wall of painted doors.

activities.name: Haul the ferry rope
activities.text: Hand over hand across the brown river, and back.

activities.name: Pick by number
activities.text: Up the ladder at the tree you are told, and down with a full basket.

activities.name: Polish the great mirror
activities.text: A soft cloth, small circles, and no breath on the glass.

activities.name: Gather shells at low water
activities.text: Between the columns while the tide is out, and back before it is not.

activities.name: Listen at the Crucible
activities.text: Strike the stone, put your ear to it, and count how long it rings.

activities.name: Carry bales at the water-gate
activities.text: From the barge up the wet steps, and set each on its mark.

activities.name: Pick mulberry leaves
activities.text: A sackful of fresh leaf for the silk sheds, twice a day.

activities.name: Score the mastic trees
activities.text: A shallow cut, a clean floor beneath, and wait for the tears.

activities.name: Unload a cog
activities.text: Sacks up from the hold and along the mole to the carts.

activities.name: Work the weigh-beam
activities.text: Hook it on, call the weight, and chalk it on the sack.

activities.name: Dust the chained books
activities.text: Shelf by shelf, with a goose-wing, and never pull on a chain.

activities.name: Muck out the stables
activities.text: Fork, barrow and fresh straw, stall by stall.

activities.name: Run messages on the Exchange
activities.text: A folded note, a name, and four bridges at a trot.

activities.name: Comb the strand for sea-glass
activities.text: Walk the tideline with your eyes down. Green is common. Blue is not.

activities.name: Load stores at the mole
activities.text: Biscuit, water and rope, down the plank and stowed.

activities.name: Sweep the Basilica steps
activities.text: Between the two glass lions, without touching either.
activities.subName: The Basilica of the Serene Matron

activities.name: Carry water in the wards
activities.text: Two pails, the long ward, and a cup at every bed.

activities.name: Read the night reports
activities.text: What the informers saw, in forty hands, most of it nothing.

activities.name: Walk the Piazza
activities.text: Twice round the square at a stroll, noticing who notices you.
activities.subName: The Hall of the Great Council

activities.name: Hear petty complaints
activities.text: A neighbour, a debt, a wife, a cat. Write each one down as if it mattered. One will.

activities.name: Write up the files
activities.text: Name, street, habit, friends. Leave out what you think and put in what you saw.

activities.name: Carry sacks to the stones
activities.text: Up the ladder with a sack on your back, and down again for the next.

activities.name: Mow the haymead
activities.text: Scythe low, step, scythe low. Keep the line with the man beside you.

activities.name: Thresh with the flail
activities.text: Swing, turn the sheaf, swing. The rhythm matters more than the arm.

activities.name: Count the ewes at noon
activities.text: Every head on the common, twice, and the same number both times.

activities.name: Pluck down
activities.text: A goose under one arm, a sack under the other, and patience.

activities.name: Read the water
activities.text: Watch the stones, the colour and the speed, and say whether a cart may cross.

activities.name: Carry a coal for a traveller
activities.text: Bank it in ash in a clay pot, and bring it a mile down the road alive.

activities.name: Prune the outer trees
activities.text: Cut to the bud that faces out. Leave the tree room to breathe.

activities.name: Splice rope
activities.text: Unlay the strands, marry them, and tuck each one three times.

activities.name: Beat the linen
activities.text: Soap, stone and paddle, until the water runs clear.

activities.name: Walk the hot horses
activities.text: Round the yard at a slow walk until the steam is off them.

activities.name: Swing the lure
activities.text: A clean circle, a clean throw, and take it away before she binds to it.

activities.name: Dress a kerbstone
activities.text: Pitch, punch and point, until the face is true.

activities.name: Stack cordwood
activities.text: Four feet high, eight feet long, and tight enough that a squirrel cannot pass.

activities.name: Walk the forest bounds
activities.text: From marked oak to marked oak, noting every snare and every stump.

activities.name: Cut reed for thatch
activities.text: Sickle low to the water, bundle, tie and stack it in the punt.

activities.name: Mend a dry-stone wall
activities.text: Two over one, one over two, and a through-stone every yard.

activities.name: Raise a cask
activities.text: Staves in the hoop, fire inside, and bend them home before they cool.

activities.name: Yoke the oxen
activities.text: Bow under the neck, pin through the bow, and a word before you ask them to pull.

activities.name: Keep the beacon watch
activities.text: Eyes on the castle tower, and the flint dry.

activities.name: Count the carts through
activities.text: A notch for each cart, and a second for each that rides too low.

activities.name: Mend nets
activities.text: Find the hole, knot it shut, find the next.

activities.name: Shave staves
activities.text: Drawknife along the grain, until the curve is right by eye.

activities.name: Hang the eels to smoke
activities.text: A hook through each, a pole of twenty, and into the dark.

activities.name: Sort a crate of books
activities.text: By subject, then by size, then by how much is missing.

activities.name: Keep the sheep off the stones
activities.text: Walk the ring, whistle the dog, and count them twice.

activities.name: Rake the salt
activities.text: Long strokes, into ridges, and let it drain.

activities.name: Ring the fog bell
activities.text: Three pulls, a count of sixty, three pulls.

activities.name: Cut oats
activities.text: Sickle low, bind the sheaf, stand it up.

activities.name: Haul a barge
activities.text: Rope over the shoulder, lean, and walk.

activities.name: Scutch flax
activities.text: Beat it, shake it, beat it again, until the straw falls out.

activities.name: Walk the horses
activities.text: Round the ring at a walk, so the buyers can see them move.

activities.name: Pick over the slag
activities.text: Crack it, look, throw it behind you. Keep the ones that shine.

activities.name: Wash the greys
activities.text: Soak, beat, rinse. The water runs like slate.

activities.name: Lay fresh brush
activities.text: Light sticks, then leaves, then walk away backwards.

activities.name: Turn the cheeses
activities.text: Every wheel, every day, and a rub of salt.

activities.name: Sweep the stair
activities.text: Top to bottom, a step at a time, leaves over the edge.

activities.name: Turn the press
activities.text: Four to the beam, and round, and listen for the run.

activities.name: Guide carts over the ford
activities.text: Stand at the white stone and point. Shout if you must.

activities.name: Strain the honey
activities.text: Comb into the cloth, and let it take its time.

activities.name: Clear the weir
activities.text: Branches, weed and worse, hauled out by hand.

activities.name: Cut peat
activities.text: Spade down, lever, lift, and lay it to dry.

activities.name: Gather by the stones
activities.text: What grows inside the ring is not what grows outside it.

activities.name: Mend the cairns
activities.text: Stone on stone, high enough to show above snow.

activities.name: Split logs for the fire
activities.text: Axe, block, and a rhythm you can keep.

activities.name: Strip osiers
activities.text: Pull each rod through the brake until it comes out white.

activities.name: Shape spokes
activities.text: Spokeshave and a good eye, twelve to a wheel.

activities.name: Dress the millstones
activities.text: Pick and bill, furrow by furrow, with grit in your teeth.

activities.name: Cut furze for the beacon
activities.text: Gloves, a hook and a bundle bigger than you are.

activities.name: Salt the catch
activities.text: Split, gut, pack in salt, and turn the barrel.

activities.name: Walk the capstan
activities.text: Chest to the bar, and round, and the ferry comes.

activities.name: Watch for sails
activities.text: Eyes on the edge of the sea, and shout the rig.

activities.name: Tend a kiln
activities.text: Keep it smouldering, never burning, and watch the run.

activities.name: Wheel herring up the hill
activities.text: A full barrow, a steep street, and a fair penny at the top.

activities.name: Walk the rounds
activities.text: Lantern high, stave low, and call the hour at each corner.

activities.name: Water the linen
activities.text: Along each strip with the can, and never let it dry in the sun.

activities.name: String the hop poles
activities.text: Ground to pole-top and down again, four strings to a hill.

activities.name: Mend a terrace wall
activities.text: Stone on stone with no mortar, and each one chosen.

activities.name: Bundle reed
activities.text: Comb it, butt it level on the board, and tie it twice.

activities.name: Fill the hermit’s basket
activities.text: Bread, an onion, and a question on a scrap of bark.

activities.name: Keep the bar
activities.text: Lift it for carts, count the wheels, and ask what is under the canvas.

activities.name: Copy a page fair
activities.text: A page of someone else’s words, set down without one of your own.

activities.name: Carry sacks ashore
activities.text: Down the plank with a sack on your shoulder, and the measurer counting.

activities.name: Trim the green lamps
activities.text: Wick, oil and glass, house by house round the square.

activities.name: Carry parcels to the grating
activities.text: Bread, a clean shirt, a note folded small. Hand each one in and say the name.

activities.name: Listen along the benches
activities.text: A cup that lasts an hour, and both ears open.

activities.name: Pitch a hull
activities.text: Hot pitch and a long brush, seam by seam.

activities.name: Gut sardines
activities.text: Thumb in, thumb out, into the basket. Mind the knife.

activities.name: Stir the vats
activities.text: A long paddle, slow and even, or the colour takes in streaks.

activities.name: Gild a row of masks
activities.text: Size, leaf, and a breath to lay it. Do not sneeze.

activities.name: Polish the stock
activities.text: Chalk and a soft cloth, in circles, until you can see what you would rather not.

activities.name: Row the line
activities.text: Ship to ship at an oar’s length, while the officer calls up his questions.

activities.name: Keep the list
activities.text: Name, ship and day, in a fair hand, and the bell rung once for each.

activities.name: Gather simples
activities.text: The right leaf at the right hour, into the right basket.

activities.name: Lift the eel traps
activities.text: Hand over hand up the line, and a quick grip behind the head.

activities.name: Sound the channel
activities.text: Lead over the bow, call the mark, and again.

activities.name: Load a barge
activities.text: Bales to the plank, plank to the hold, and trim her level.

activities.name: Feed the worms
activities.text: Fresh leaves on every tray, the old ones lifted away, and not a sound.

activities.name: Turn the sluice wheel
activities.text: Shoulder to the spoke, and round, and the gate comes up a finger.

activities.name: Sift for cullet
activities.text: Shake the sieve, pick the glass, and keep your fingers.

activities.name: Row the circuit
activities.text: Once round the Isles, slowly, counting lamps.

activities.name: Stack biscuit
activities.text: Off the peel, on to the rack, and count by the hundred.

activities.name: Roll casks to the mole
activities.text: Tip it, turn it, and keep your toes out of the way.

activities.name: Shoot at the butts
activities.text: Wind, lay the bolt, and loose on the roll.

activities.name: Tag the pledges
activities.text: A ticket for each, a line in the book, and up the ladder.

activities.name: Watch for the fleet
activities.text: Eyes east, and call the number of sails.

activities.name: Scrape a hull
activities.text: Weed, shell and old tallow, down to the wood.

activities.name: Shave an oar blank
activities.text: Long strokes with the grain, and stop before you think you should.

activities.name: Weigh foreign coin
activities.text: On the scale, in the book, and a mark for every light one.

activities.name: Sift pepper
activities.text: Shake, pick, and weigh what is left.

activities.name: Work the strings
activities.text: Two hands, four strings, and never look at your own fingers.

activities.name: Bail the boats
activities.text: A scoop, a sponge and forty hulls before the first fare.

activities.name: Pour for the shift
activities.text: A row of cups, filled before the bell stops.

activities.name: Walk the rope
activities.text: Backwards, feeding hemp, at the pace of the wheel.

activities.name: Cut greens for the boats
activities.text: Knife low, basket full, and down to the landing.

activities.name: Teach the choir its notes
activities.text: One line at a time, until forty voices make one.

activities.name: Row the crossing
activities.text: Over and back, standing, and never touch another boat.

activities.name: Wring the sheets
activities.text: Two to a sheet, twist against each other, and hang it square.

activities.name: Polish the water-hall
activities.text: Wax, cloth, and every tile until it shows the ceiling.

activities.name: Shovel sand ashore
activities.text: Swing, throw, swing. The barge rises as you empty it.

activities.name: String beads
activities.text: Dip the wires, shake, and slide them down the thread.

activities.name: Read to the old masters
activities.text: The news from the city, slowly, and twice for the deaf ones.

activities.name: Hoist the signals
activities.text: Bend on, haul up, and hold until the castle answers.

activities.name: Haul a block ashore
activities.text: Rope, rollers and the ox-team, before the tide turns.

activities.name: Tend a diver’s line
activities.text: Pay out, feel for the tug, and haul like your own life.

activities.name: Carry oil up the path
activities.text: One jar, four hundred steps, and do not look down.

activities.name: Clip the hedges
activities.text: Shears along the string, and sweep up after.

activities.name: Lie in wait for duck
activities.text: Flat in the punt, bolt ready, until they come in to land.

activities.name: Turn the drying rice
activities.text: Rake it over, every row, every hour.

activities.name: Ladle out the bark-water
activities.text: A cup each, and watch that they swallow.

activities.name: Serve the common table
activities.text: Bread, the pot, the jug, and round again.

activities.name: Stack green bricks
activities.text: On edge, a finger apart, so the fire can walk between.

activities.name: Lash a raft
activities.text: Chain through the dogs, haul tight, and hammer the wedge.

activities.name: Haul on the weight
activities.text: Up on the line, drop on the word.

activities.name: Rake the pans
activities.text: Push the crust to the edge and heap it to drain.

activities.name: Strip a pole
activities.text: Twist the rope of shell free and into the boat.

activities.name: Wind up the spoon
activities.text: Round the windlass until the mud breaks surface.

activities.name: Fill the lamps
activities.text: Oil, wick, and light each one from the last.

activities.name: Haul the seine
activities.text: Twenty hands on the rope, and walk it up the beach.

activities.name: Grease the chain
activities.text: Link by link, tallow to the elbow.

activities.name: Turn the bales
activities.text: Hook, heave, and let the air at the other side.

activities.name: Copy bills of health
activities.text: Ship, port, crew, deaths. In a fair hand, twice.

activities.name: Ring the hours
activities.text: Pull, clank, count, and pull again.

activities.name: Cry the wares
activities.text: Loud, fast, and cheaper than the next boat.

activities.name: Spear cuttlefish
activities.text: Lantern low, look for the eye, and strike behind it.

activities.name: Ram the mould
activities.text: Sand, tamp, sand, tamp, until it rings solid.

activities.name: Scrape a hide
activities.text: Over the beam, flesh side up, long strokes.

activities.name: Wind bobbins
activities.text: Thread on to each, even and tight, a hundred before noon.

activities.name: Turn the oyster tiles
activities.text: Lift, scrape the weed off, and set them back.

activities.name: Sort the coral
activities.text: By colour, by thickness, and the dead white thrown back.

activities.name: Plough a strip
activities.text: Walk the ox down your furrow and back, and keep the line the reeve can see.

activities.name: Sow the spring corn
activities.text: Seed from the apron, a handful to every third step.

activities.name: Weed the furrows
activities.text: Dock and thistle out by the root, strip after strip.

activities.name: Glean the stubble
activities.text: What the reapers dropped is yours, if you are quick.

activities.name: Drive the flock up
activities.text: Up the hill before the dew is off, with the dogs wide on either side.

activities.name: Watch the flock
activities.text: Sit where you can count them. Count them again.

activities.name: Tend the hives
activities.text: Smoke first, slow hands, and no talking near the skeps.

activities.name: Gather hill herbs
activities.text: Yarrow and thyme from the high side, cut while the dew holds.

activities.name: Bake the bread
activities.text: Fire the oven, shape the loaves, and mark yours with a thumb.

activities.name: Work the loom
activities.text: Shuttle and beat, shuttle and beat, a hand of cloth by noon.

activities.name: Brew small ale
activities.text: Mash, boil and cool, and keep the neighbours out of the wort.

activities.name: Hoe the onions
activities.text: Between the rows, shallow, before the sun is high.

activities.name: Water the plots
activities.text: Two pails from the well to every bed, in the cool of the evening.

activities.name: Serve the evening crowd
activities.text: Jugs out, pots back, and an ear for who owes whom.

activities.name: Roll at the kegel-alley
activities.text: Nine pins, three balls, and the loser fills the jug.

activities.name: Swap stories by the fire
activities.text: Yours for theirs. The ale-wife has heard both.

activities.name: Wrestle on the green
activities.text: Collar and elbow, best of three falls.

activities.name: Play for the green
activities.text: A reel to start with, and whatever they shout for after.

activities.name: Feed the village fire
activities.text: A log for the hearth that never goes out, and a word to Ilvara.

activities.name: Draw water at the well
activities.text: Rope, pail and a wet sleeve, four turns to the top.

activities.name: Forge nails
activities.text: Rod, heat, point, head, cut. A hundred before noon.

activities.name: Mend tools for the market
activities.text: Sickles, hinges and a pot with no handle. Each wants a different heat.

activities.name: Strike for the master
activities.text: She holds and turns. You swing the sledge where she taps, and nowhere else.
